notes.title: Major Camelbirds Update!
notes.content:
We're excited to introduce a major Camelbirds update featuring new game modes, unique maps, substantial improvements, and numerous fixes, significantly enhancing your gameplay!

What's New:

Arena: Compete against others in the new "King of the Hill" mode!
New maps: Temple, Delta, Wild West Arena, Aztec Arena.
Updated Hub: Interactive shooting range, training track, and "Ostriczino."
Improvements:

Optimized performance for PC and PCVR.
Smarter and more responsive AI.
Revamped interface for enhanced user experience.
Improved balance for fairer matches.
Enhanced interaction quality and audio.
Various updates to objects, events, controls, and tools.
Fixes:

Improved stability and crash fixes.
Interface and collision bug fixes.
Store purchase bug resolved.
Log into Camelbirds and experience all the new features! See you in the Arena!

notes.title: Daily Fix Ver. 1.0.2
notes.content:
Added AI names.
The single-player menu map has been fixed.
The race finale (on the podium) has been improved.
All levels are now completed in 3 laps.
Connection problems have been fixed.
Other minor bugs have been fixed.
